about: SandboxVille rooms, one zip each. Put a zip in the add-rooms-here folder of SandboxVille Lobby; SandboxVille checks its sha256 against its own catalog before it opens it.

rooms.name: The Terrarium
rooms.blurb: Small animals, each run by its own little brain of neurons. Your AI can count them and nudge them, never harm them.

rooms.name: The Library
rooms.blurb: Search one folder of your notes. Your AI can read them one at a time, only inside that folder, never change them.

rooms.name: The Desk
rooms.blurb: Grade forecasts against what really happened. Paper trades only: it never places a trade.
